_note: Curated selects for the homepage. Two passes over the same criteria: frames 1-36 graded directly by the curator, 37-72 by three independent graders working from the same written standard and the curator's worked examples. A = can carry a full-bleed beat. B = real support. C = reject. Any frame carrying a flag is excluded from the homepage regardless of grade.

criteria.A: Hero-grade: beautiful light, simple strong composition, looks expensive. Full-bleed capable.
criteria.B: Good support: real and usable, not strong enough for full bleed.
criteria.C: Reject: AC units, cables, utility poles, clutter, plastic furniture, catering gear, flat light, snapshot framing.

flags.reason: A lone cyclist on a mountain ridge with dramatic sky — a stock sports frame used to illustrate Bike Tours. Not the property.
Rows of municipal umbrellas in a bay; this is a town beach (probably Rethymno), not the private beach.
Infinity pool overlooking mountains and an inland valley. Thalasses stands about 50 m from the sea; this is very likely a different Crete Holiday Home property.
Lone cyclist silhouetted on an open road at sunset is classic generic stock sports photography, with nothing of the property in frame; must not appear on the homepage.
Natural rocky shoreline and a family walking a public coastal path rather than the villa grounds; plausibly the adjacent Crete coast but also reads like lifestyle stock, so worth a review.

Generic branded Mythos beer product shot on a plain white surface with shallow depth of field — indistinguishable from commercial stock beverage photography and carries no Thalasses signature. Cannot be verified as the property's own imagery; recommend a review before any use.
The same Mythos beer bucket image, stored on the site as Rituals-p-4.webp. Even if it was shot on site, it reads as third-party brand stock and shows another company's logo rather than Thalasses.

This is the Venetian gate of the Fortezza fortress in Rethymno town — a public monument with visitors and a Greek Republic restoration signboard in frame, not Thalasses Villas. Acceptable only as area/destination content, never as property imagery.

Industrial stainless catering kitchen with extractor hood and commercial range — reads like a restaurant or off-site cooking-class venue rather than any villa space at Thalasses. Worth confirming it was shot on the property.
Tight branded coffee-machine and capsule close-up with no property context at all — indistinguishable from generic product/stock imagery. Confirm it is in-villa photography before use.
